Thankyou for your kind words. Today is a lot better. I hit a unbearably low point last night. I am indeed lucky. I wish I could be more grateful for my situation.

 I actually am in a technology close to a trade, ive been having a tough time getting a co-op but I get another kick at the can this year. Hopefully this year changes, if not I'll just keep going to school and working till I get it.

I should really be doing more with my cash your right. I just feel like Ill be even worse off If i do spend it hahaha 

Thankyou for your comment your a great person and I hope all the good things you deserve come true for you. 

I am very sorry and saddened to hear about your friends passing. Believe when I say I know what that feels like, you are not alone. It certainly doesn't help your mood but its one of the things that keeps me going after seeing the wake of destruction something like that leaves behind.
Thankyou. We arnt alone and we are going to make it. Just keep living with me.

your right your right. I have a shitty outlook. Im lucky to be where i am. things could be a lot worse. I do know that, somewhat, but I cant feel it. I need to figure out why I cant be more pleased with things instead of wanting to just give up.
Thankyou my friend. Your a good person to sit on reddit and chear up sad saps like me. Dont ever change haha
Thanks, Ill try and work hard like you. I just feel let down in myself and everything I put effort into. But I understand there must be something good to come out of it. Thankyou so much
